card.name: Start of a follow-up sentence in labels
card.fires_on: Sentence-starting or clause-linking words such as "This", "not" or "is" that refer back to a point just made in drug-label prose. Also fires on a few words that finish a term that was just introduced, such as "program" or "incompatibility".

modes.label: This after a finding
modes.description: The word "This" opens a sentence that comments on the effect or finding stated just before it.

modes.description: A small linking or verb word continues a statement about a risk or finding.
